name: server
description: Backend server for the e-commerce system selling electronic components and devices

scripts.prestart: corepack pnpm@12.3.4 prisma:prepare && corepack pnpm@12.3.4 build:compile
scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && concurrently -k -n tsc,node "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch --watch-path=dist dist/src/server.js"
scripts.build: node scripts/prisma-generate.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.vercel-build: node scripts/prisma-generate.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.prisma:prepare: corepack pnpm@12.3.4 prisma:generate && corepack pnpm@12.3.4 prisma:migrate:deploy
scripts.docker:up: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c "cd /mnt/e/Code/digital-e-shop/server && docker compose --env-file .env.docker up -d"
scripts.docker:down: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c "cd /mnt/e/Code/digital-e-shop/server && docker compose --env-file .env.docker down"
scripts.docker:import: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c "cd /mnt/e/Code/digital-e-shop/server && grep -v GTID_PURGED src/database/migrations/defaultdb_2026-06-01_142319.sql | docker exec -i digitale-mysql mysql -uroot -pdigital_e_root digital_e_shop_local && docker exec -i digitale-mysql mysql -uroot -pdigital_e_root digital_e_shop_local < src/database/migrations/2026-07-07-add-stripe-payment-support.sql"
scripts.docker:migrate: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c "cd /mnt/e/Code/digital-e-shop/server && NODE_ENV=development DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=3307 DB_USER=root DB_PASSWORD=digital_e_root DB_NAME=digital_e_shop_local DATABASE_URL=mysql://root:digital_e_root@127.0.0.1:3307/digital_e_shop_local pnpm prisma:migrate:resolve --applied 0_init && NODE_ENV=development DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=3307 DB_USER=root DB_PASSWORD=digital_e_root DB_NAME=digital_e_shop_local DATABASE_URL=mysql://root:digital_e_root@127.0.0.1:3307/digital_e_shop_local pnpm prisma:migrate:deploy"
scripts.docker:seed:mock: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c "cd /mnt/e/Code/digital-e-shop/server && NODE_ENV=development DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=3307 DB_USER=root DB_PASSWORD=digital_e_root DB_NAME=digital_e_shop_local DATABASE_URL=mysql://root:digital_e_root@127.0.0.1:3307/digital_e_shop_local MOCK_ORDER_COUNT=50 MOCK_REVIEW_COUNT=50 node src/database/seeders/seedMockOrdersReviews.js"
scripts.docker:setup: pnpm docker:up && pnpm docker:import && pnpm docker:migrate && pnpm docker:seed && pnpm docker:verify
scripts.docs:open: echo Open http://localhost:4000/docs in your browser
